measurement_caveat: Events timestamp nonempty client-side SSE text receipts. Empty or coalesced text means receipt counts need not equal completion token counts; receipt gaps are not engine token timings. Outputs are forced with ignore_eos; no answer quality is measured. Each arm ran once, MuxPD before native; no significance claim.
scope: wl38; six workloads; one pass per TP2/TP4 native/MuxPD arm

selection_rule.gain: both TPs goodput >= +5pp or both throughputs >= +5%
selection_rule.very good: both TPs goodput >= +15pp, throughput >= -2%, zero errors
